settings.heading: The right yak chew for your French Bulldog.
settings.subheading: Frenchies are enthusiastic chewers with compact jaws. They need a chew sized for their strength — not too big, not too small.
settings.estimate_note: French Bulldogs (20–28 lbs) typically do well with a Small or Medium. Their shorter muzzle means they gnaw rather than power-chew.
settings.card_1_text: Most French Bulldogs weigh 20–28 lbs. A Small works for lighter Frenchies; a Medium is better for stockier ones or those who chew aggressively.
settings.card_2_text: Yak chews work well for flat-faced breeds because dogs can grip them with their side teeth. Unlike round toys, the rectangular shape gives Frenchies a comfortable hold.
settings.card_3_text: French Bulldogs are prone to separation anxiety. A yak chew given 2–3 minutes before you leave builds a calm-time ritual that reduces stress.
